Crime & Law · India

Daycare Abuse Allegations and Ram Mandir Donation Claims Surface

Allegations of toddler mistreatment at a Bengaluru Capgemini daycare center have led to the whistleblower's arrest, with police claiming she also abused children. The Karnataka State Commission for Protection of Child Rights proposed stricter daycare regulations. Separately, the Ram Mandir Trust stated all donations, including over 30 kg of gold and 1,500 kg of silver, are safe and recorded amid embezzlement allegations. The National Human Rights Commission issued notices to Karnataka and Madhya Pradesh over alleged toddler abuse.
